app.name: WiiWaker
app.short_description: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker Native Wii Port
app.long_description: A native Nintendo Wii homebrew port of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker based on the complete C++ decompilation. Features 729 MHz CPU execution, 88MB RAM utilization, 16:9 widescreen 480p, and full Wii Remote + MotionPlus support including authentic baton conducting gestures.
